character_view.agenda: Get temporary access to the archive without owing a personal favor.
visible_evidence: The archivist can authorize one supervised visit.
A refundable deposit is an accepted institutional condition.

causal_trajectory.action: Eli offers the standard refundable deposit instead of a personal favor.
causal_trajectory.effect: The archivist accepts and signs a one-visit supervised access slip.

fixture.candidate: Eli pays the refundable deposit, receives the signed one-visit access slip, and leaves knowing he can enter the archive once under supervision.

rubric: Accept a candidate when the supplied character-visible evidence supports the action and the durable state changes are explicitly caused by an observable agreement or action in the trajectory.
Do not reject merely because the character solved the immediate problem efficiently; supported competence is not a continuity failure.
Use NARR-SUPPORTED when the action, knowledge, and candidate state delta all remain inside the supplied evidence and causal chain.
